notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 1156 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Ti; $\Delta H^{\circ}=1.017$ kcal/mol. 1945 K, melting point of Ti; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 3.300$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 10.970 + 1.760 \times 10^{-3} T$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 10.970 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.880 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 3.349$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-1156 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -82.249 + 1.322 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.403 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 48.950 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -82.249 - 1.322 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} + 0.403 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 24.475 \text{T}^{-1} + 29.408 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1156-1945 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -86.286 + 3.722 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.726 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 733.950 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -86.286 - 3.722 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} + 0.726 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 366.975 \text{T}^{-1} + 49.161 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1945-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -79.154 - 4.251 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.720 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 34.150 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -79.154 + 4.251 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 0.720 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 17.075 \text{T}^{-1} - 11.972 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Pelino (97). Other data are those estimated by Mills (80).
